traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for Story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are fully implemented and verified: - File-level @supports templates are automatically inserted for test files missing annotations, using a clear placeholder JSDoc block with explicit TODO guidance and no semantic inference. - Malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in test names are normalized in a controlled, format-only manner (spacing, casing, delimiters, bracket vs. parentheses), while tests with no REQ prefix remain unmodified aside from reported errors. - Fixes are guarded by configuration flags (autoFixTestTemplate, autoFixTestPrefixFormat), use ESLint’s fixer API, and preserve existing formatting, quoting, and test bodies. - Behavior is thoroughly covered by RuleTester tests and documented in user-docs/api-reference.md, and the overall test suite passes. Therefore, the story is assessed as PASSED.
